source_references.population_note: Original BodyParts3D4.3 source-curated adult male TARO reference, constructed using MRI plus illustrator edits; not native patient segmentation. Source objects retain their complete source extent, authored normals and face order. This chosen source presentation keeps overlapping gland/chiasm/right-ICA editing forms separate; they are not additional tissues or confirmed anatomical variants. Catalogue-mapped left optic objects retain mirrored/right-filename provenance. FJ3483 is held because its left-ICA mapping conflicts with its common-carotid filename and inferior source location. Original XYZ and header-declared mm are retained; acquisition calibration and independent patient directions remain unverified. These source surfaces are separate from the publication MRI/CT cases and the current report; there is no fitting or registration, no supplied fine capsule/fascicle/wall/branch geometry, no disease or function inference, and no complete reporting-anatomy/clinical approval.
